# All bass multi-effects — comparison

[Guitar](all-guitar.md) · [Bass](all-bass.md) · [Vocal](all-vocal.md) · [Category](MULTI-EFFECTS.md) · [Repository](README.md)

178 recorded bass-focused or explicitly documented bass-capable multi-effects: 40 bass-focused and 138 shared models. This compares actual model records, not only bass-branded units. Capability evidence is listed below; it does not establish equal low-end retention or every effect working equally well on bass.

These are **comparisons of the recorded catalogue**, not exhaustive market coverage or fresh stock certification. Organized 2026-10-16 from the linked source records; their original technical/price dates, firmware, revision and access limits still apply. Every model remains partial. **? means unverified, not No.** Read the complete linked record for sources and conflicting evidence; this view does not silently resolve those conflicts.

K/F/B = independently adjustable rotary controls / footswitches / separate buttons; toe and power switches are additional unless explicitly stated. Body axes and mass qualifications are retained. Color does not prove touch; USB audio does not prove bus power; IRs, native NAM, converted NAM and proprietary captures differ.

| [BOSS GT-1000CORE](brand/BOSS.md#gt-1000core) | **Built-in / external expression:** No built-in treadle or toe switch; two shared CTL/EXP sockets for direct analog pedals. SYSTEM preference + EXP1/EXP2 FOOT VOL shares the target across patches. Competing patch ASSIGN priority remains unverified.<br>**Expression / combined function choices:** Indexed original [CORE Parameter Guide, eng01, CONTROL FUNCTION table](https://static.roland.com/assets/media/pdf/GT-1000CORE_prm_eng01_W.pdf), checked2026-11-03: EXP1/EXP2 choices are **OFF, FOOT VOL, PEDAL FX, FV/PD FX, FV+TUNER, FVTU/PFX**. PEDAL FX follows the selected wah/pedal-bend effect. FV+TUNER opens the tuner at full heel; FVTU/PFX does so when using its foot-volume role. These are alternative function settings, not six analog inputs, a guaranteed always-active volume role or proof of attenuation during tuner bypass. SYSTEM target sharing remains separately documented; range, competing ASSIGN priority and output coverage stay qualified. Original indexed table only; full current2.02 guide equivalence and hardware behavior unverified.<br>**Expression / external toe and calibration limits:** Roland exact-model articles, updated **2026-05-20**, checked **2026-11-03**: [toe-end switch assignment through EXP is unsupported](https://support.roland.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054113912-GT-1000CORE-Can-the-toe-end-of-an-expression-pedal-be-used-as-a-switch-to-turn-WAH-on-off); [neither CTL2,3/EXP1 nor CTL4,5/EXP2 has expression calibration](https://support.roland.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054113872-GT-1000CORE-Does-it-have-an-expression-pedal-calibration-function). Separate CTL contacts and midpoint-triggered ASSIGNs are different mechanisms. No universal third-party/M-VAVE pinout compatibility inferred. SYSTEM FOOT VOL remains documented, with range/placement/coverage qualifications unchanged.<br>**Expression volume placement / range / recall:** Movable FV block, including parallel chains; uniform factory placement unknown. MIN/MAX/position 0–100 and four curves are patch parameters; no SYSTEM range override established. EXP HOLD retains angle when the destination function matches; recall is separate from assignment.<br>**Expression volume coverage / bypass:** Headphone, tail and recorded-loop attenuation unverified. Tuner MUTE/BYPASS/THRU are distinct; no explicit pedal-sweep guarantee in bypass. Momentary/latching toe type is configurable. Reaching that position bypasses the assigned target(s) after the delay; toe switching selects the other bank and bypasses the previous targets, as in Classic. Classic-assigned parameters are locked against editing elsewhere; Advanced/Auto-Engage parameters remain editable. Saving recalls the internal **A/B bank state**, not proven held-pedal position. Assignment range uses percentages of the target’s own range, not a universal dB/mute range. These rig-level settings do not establish global volume or headphone/tail/loop coverage. [FAQ](https://load2.kemper-amps.com/faqs);[OS14](https://www.kemper-amps.com/news).<br>**PROFILE2.0 capture workflow / ports:** **OS14.2 pp.189–190:** Requires current desktop Rig Manager Windows/macOS and its Profiling Assistant. Creates Studio,Direct and Liquid PROFILEs. **Right Monitor Out becomes profiling send** to reference amp input;Player instrument input becomes microphone/DI return. Its TS unbalanced input may need an adapter. Monitor via XLR main,left Monitor Out or headphones;stereo XLR monitoring requires special adapter. Starting Rig effects carry into the new Rig. Switching reference/Kemper evaluation requires exchanging microphone/guitar at the input;after capture restore guitar input,save,and exit via Bank. Direct capture uses suitable DI equipment. This does not add a dedicated capture/mic input,phantom power or live vocal classification. The manuscript retains older Head/Rack/Stage-only creation wording in its Liquid Profile chapter p.177;the explicit Player capture chapter supersedes that limitation for this revision. This is import acceptance,not unlimited internal processing length or extra Rig memory;internal truncation/format limits unresolved. Imported Output presets warrant Player-specific review because ports differ. IR presets,amp PROFILEs and NAM files remain distinct. Signal Flow and Stomp are distinct control contexts.<br>**Routing / Split bypass and Dynamic ambiguity:** [Own3.80 RevD pp38–39](brand/LINE6.md#hx-effects--split-bypass-and-dynamic-reverse-ambiguity): bypassing Split feeds both stereo channels equally to both paths. Dynamic switches by input level, not note tracking; its Reverse description repeats the normal direction, so actual reversal remains unverified.<br>**Routing / external-loop dry and tail scope:** [Own3.80 RevD](brand/LINE6.md#hx-effects--external-loop-dry-paths-and-tail-scope): Send and Dry Thr are independent; Return/FX Loop Mix0% keeps dry,100% excludes it. FX Loop Trails On permits external decay on block bypass/snapshot change; not universal EXP attenuation or preset spillover.<br>**Practical features:** Analog relay or DSP bypass with trails,snapshots,parallel routing,four/seven-cable integration,MIDI/amp control andPedal Edit. **One looper block maximum per preset**,using one of9 blocks:6 Switch,1 Switch orShuffling,inmono/stereo. **6/1Switch full-speed60s mono/30s stereo;half-speed120s mono/60s stereo**. Shuffling60s mono/30s stereo,nohalf-speed entry. Preset changes retain playback only with the **same looper model AND mono/stereo type**. Six-switch controls include overdub,last-overdub undo,play-once,reverse andspeed. From **3.50**, Snapshot Control can be disabled per parameter assigned to EXP, footswitch or MIDI, so snapshots need not restore that parameter’s value; this does not remove its controller assignment. **Firmware3.10:** tuner Trails keeps delay/reverb tails and looper running. Shuffling Looper replaces its earlier Octaves probability with Pitch plus Interval1/2 (−1 to+1octave). Reload/change the model to expose new parameters in existing presets; saved defaults need resaving. Command Center Instant commands gain up to1000ms Wait Time. CC69 snapshot changes received during preset loads are buffered until loading completes. **Shuffling controls (3.80 p.29):** Slices and SeqLen set chop count and sequence length; Shuffle/Pitch/Reverse/Repeat/Drift control random behavior. Smooth softens slice joins; Playback and Low/Hi Cut shape playback. Interval1/2 span −1 to +1 octave. Parameters can be controller-assigned. Press during playback reshuffles; double-press stops while retaining audio; hold during playback or stop deletes it. Shuffle0% with equal Slices/SeqLen isolates pitch/reverse processing. HXE-D p.29 **Global-settings reset preserves presets** (3.80 p.48); this is not evidence that a full factory reset preserves them. Drum machine remains unverified. HXE-F; HXE-D pp.25,27–28,48; HXE-R350; HXE-R310<br>**Controller assignments / stereo routing:** **3.80 manual pp.40–43:** Mono blocks sum both channels. Legacy distortion/dynamics/pitch-synth are mono; filter/reverb stereo; modulation/delay vary. EXP1 defaults to Wah/Pitch Wham/Poly Wham control and bypass; EXP2 to Volume/Pan control when added through Signal Flow. FS1–6 toggle parameter endpoints; momentary/latching applies per switch, not per assignment. Swapping endpoints reverses control. Reserved global MIDI CCs cannot control parameters. Clear All removes snapshot and default pedal assignments too. Command Center stores assignments per preset, offers six automatic Instant commands, and sends MIDI commands through DIN OUT and USB together; command availability depends on source. Instant CC/Bank-Program/MMC/HX Looper values and CC Toggle/Ext Amp states follow snapshots. HXE-D pp.40–43<br>**Looper / playback versus overdub:** Playbk adjusts recorded-loop playback separately from live guitar. Ovrdub reduces the existing loop on successive overdub passes:90% retains90% each pass. ## Scope and provenance

Instrument views overlap and must not be summed. All 402 active models count once in `research-state.json`; the six explicitly excluded archives never enter these tables. Former/donated eligible devices remain without private receipt/order/payment details. Root brand records take precedence where consolidated; legacy sources remain for full evidence until a checked lossless merge. No GitHub workflow is used.
